subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Narrative Transportation
description: A micro-lesson that makes Narrative Transportation usable.

hook.text: A charity showed statistics: 3 million face famine. Donations were low. They showed one girl's story. Donations doubled.

buildup.text: Narrative transportation pulls the audience into a story. Once transported, critical thinking drops and emotional.

discovery.text: Green and Brock found transported readers accepted story-consistent claims more easily, even when the claims.

twist.text: Brands use storytelling to bypass rational evaluation. A compelling origin story makes the product feel more authentic.

climax.text: Great stories persuade. When a brand's story moves you, pause and evaluate the product separately from the narrative.

punchline.text: A good story can sell anything. That is the danger.
